name: Chess Master Ailsa

intro.text: Eight by eight, sixty-four squares, thirty-two pieces. We'll use the ivory ones, you and I, only they're a bit bigger and they bite. I play black. I always play black. White is for people with no sense of occasion.

win: Checkmate, in a manner of speaking. Well played. You've a mind for it.
after: I'll be at the board when you want a rematch. I'm always at the board.
